PARAMS = {
    "W_pass":     (1000.0, 500.0, 2500.0),   # um, pass PMOS total width
    "L_pass":     (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),         # um, pass + gate-diode length
    "K_mir":      (100.0, 40.0, 250.0),      # pass / gate-diode width ratio
    "W_md":       (20.0, 5.0, 80.0),         # um, NMOS gate driver (L=0.5)
    "Rg":         (100e3, 30e3, 300e3),      # gate pull-up resistor to vin
    "Rz":         (27e3, 8e3, 80e3),         # lag-network resistor (fast-path gain)
    "Cz":         (120e-12, 30e-12, 500e-12),# lag-network capacitor (zero ~50 kHz)
    "W_in":       (20.0, 5.0, 60.0),         # um, PMOS input pair (L=1)
    "tail_ratio": (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),           # tail current = 5uA * ratio
    "Rdiv":       (240e3, 100e3, 600e3),     # total feedback divider
}

def _op(lut, dev, W, L, vgs, vds):
    try:
        return lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)
    except Exception:
        return None

def _solve(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
    o = None
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        o = _op(lut, dev, W, L, mid, vds)
        if o is None:
            break
        if o["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    o = _op(lut, dev, W, L, v, vds)
    if o is None:  # crude fallback
        gmid = 10.0
        o = {"Id": Id, "gm": gmid * Id, "gds": Id / 3.0, "vth": 0.8,
             "vdsat": 0.15, "gm_id": gmid, "cgg": W * L * 9e-15}
        v = 0.9
    return v, o

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vout = spec["vout_target"]; cl = spec["cl"]
    imin = spec["iload_min"]; imax = spec["iload_max"]
    beta = vref / vout
    Rdiv = p["Rdiv"]; R2 = Rdiv * beta; R1 = Rdiv - R2
    idiv = vout / Rdiv
    Wp, Lp, K = p["W_pass"], p["L_pass"], p["K_mir"]
    Wdl = max(0.42, Wp / K)
    Wmd, Rg, Rz, Cz = p["W_md"], p["Rg"], p["Rz"], p["Cz"]
    Win, tr = p["W_in"], p["tail_ratio"]
    itail = 5e-6 * tr

    # ---------------- stage 1 (PMOS pair, NMOS mirror load, L=1) ----------
    vsg1, o1 = _solve(lut, "p", Win, 1.0, itail / 2, 0.85)
    vgsl, ol = _solve(lut, "n", 4.0, 1.0, itail / 2, 0.55)
    gm1 = o1["gm"]
    ro1 = 1.0 / (o1["gds"] + ol["gds"])
    A1dc = gm1 * ro1
    A1h = gm1 * (ro1 * Rz / (ro1 + Rz))
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    Zb = complex(Rz, -1.0 / (w1k * Cz))
    Z1k = 1.0 / (1.0 / ro1 + 1.0 / Zb)
    A1_1k = gm1 * abs(Z1k)

    # ---------------- pass + gate driver at several loads ------------------
    def stage2(il):
        ip = il + idiv
        vsg, op_ = _solve(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, ip, vin - vout)
        gm_p, gds_p = op_["gm"], op_["gds"]
        gm_dl = gm_p / K
        i_md = ip / K + vsg / Rg
        vgsd, od = _solve(lut, "n", Wmd, 0.5, i_md, max(0.1, vin - vsg))
        Zg = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rg + gm_dl + od["gds"])
        A2 = od["gm"] * Zg
        cg = op_["cgg"] * (1.0 + 1.0 / K)
        return dict(vsg=vsg, gm_p=gm_p, gds_p=gds_p, i_md=i_md, vgsd=vgsd,
                    gm_d=od["gm"], gds_d=od["gds"], Zg=Zg, A2=A2, cg=cg)

    loads = list(np.logspace(math.log10(imin), math.log10(imax), 7))
    st = [stage2(il) for il in loads]
    lo, hi = st[0], st[-1]

    # HF loop transconductance / crossover / gate pole
    Ghf_hi = A1h * beta * hi["A2"] * hi["gm_p"]
    Ghf_lo = A1h * beta * lo["A2"] * lo["gm_p"]
    fu_hi = Ghf_hi / (2 * PI * cl); fu_lo = Ghf_lo / (2 * PI * cl)
    fg_hi = 1.0 / (2 * PI * hi["Zg"] * hi["cg"])
    fg_lo = 1.0 / (2 * PI * lo["Zg"] * lo["cg"])
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * Cz)
    pm_hi = 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(fu_hi / fz)) - 90 \
        - math.degrees(math.atan(fu_hi / fg_hi)) + 90 - 90
    pm_hi = 180 - 90 - 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(fu_hi / fz)) \
        - math.degrees(math.atan(fu_hi / fg_hi))
    pm_lo = 180 - 90 - 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(fu_lo / fz)) \
        - math.degrees(math.atan(fu_lo / fg_lo))

    # undershoot: fast path must carry the step until Cz catches up
    undershoot = 1.3 * (imax - imin) / max(Ghf_hi, 1e-6)

    # PSRR @1kHz (gate tracks vin through diode/Rg): ~ 1/(A1 beta A2 gm_p ro_p)
    psrr = min(20 * math.log10(1 + A1_1k * beta * s["A2"] * s["gm_p"] / s["gds_p"])
               for s in (lo, hi))

    # load regulation: integrate 1/gm_eff plus systematic driver-VGS offset
    dv = 0.0
    for i in range(len(loads) - 1):
        g_a = A1dc * beta * st[i]["A2"] * st[i]["gm_p"]
        g_b = A1dc * beta * st[i + 1]["A2"] * st[i + 1]["gm_p"]
        dv += (loads[i + 1] - loads[i]) * 0.5 * (1 / g_a + 1 / g_b)
    dv += (hi["vgsd"] - lo["vgsd"]) / (A1dc * beta)
    load_reg = dv / (imax - imin)

    # line regulation
    line_reg = lo["gds_p"] / (A1dc * beta * lo["A2"] * lo["gm_p"]) \
        + (lo["gds_d"] / max(lo["gm_d"], 1e-9)) / (A1dc * beta) \
        + 1.0 / (A1dc * beta * 200.0)

    # accuracy: systematic offset from driver VGS vs mirror-load VGS
    voff = abs(lo["vgsd"] - vgsl) / A1dc / beta
    vout_err = 100 * (voff + 1e-3) / vout

    iq = 10e-6 + 5e-6 + itail + lo["i_md"] + idiv

    # residual slow tail of the lag doublet in the 7-10 us window
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * fz)
    e0 = (imax - imin) / max(Ghf_hi, 1e-6)
    ripple = e0 * (math.exp(-7e-6 / tau) - math.exp(-10e-6 / tau))

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------------------------------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> 5uA -> PMOS diode -> PMOS tail
    n.M("Mb1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mb2", "nb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mb3", "nb", "nb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 8.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "nb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 8.0 * tr, 1.0)
    # stage 1: PMOS pair (bulk = tail for headroom), NMOS mirror load
    n.M("M1", "da", "vref", "tail", "tail", "pfet", Win, 1.0)
    n.M("M2", "n1", "fb", "tail", "tail", "pfet", Win, 1.0)
    n.M("Mn1", "da", "da", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Mn2", "n1", "da", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)
    # lag network (sets fast-path gain gm1*Rz, zero at 1/(Rz Cz))
    n.R("Rz", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cz", "nz", "vss", Cz)
    # gate driver: NMOS sink, PMOS diode (mirror of pass) + Rg to vin
    n.M("Md", "g", "n1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wmd, 0.5)
    n.M("Mdl", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wdl, Lp)
    n.R("Rg", "vin", "g", Rg)
    # pass device
    n.M("Mp", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # feedback divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    pred = {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": ripple,
        "fu_heavy_Hz": fu_hi, "fu_light_Hz": fu_lo,
        "fgate_heavy_Hz": fg_hi, "fgate_light_Hz": fg_lo,
        "fz_Hz": fz, "pm_heavy_deg": pm_hi, "pm_light_deg": pm_lo,
        "A1dc": A1dc, "A1hf": A1h,
    }
    return n, pred
